title: Naoxintong capsule attenuates heart damage after ischemic stroke via Nuclear factor-kappaB / Pyrin domain-containing protein 3 / Caspase-1 signaling.
authors: Zhang, Jing; Li, Yu; Chang, Mengli; Lei, Yuxin; Xu, He; Zhang, Yi; Xu, Jing; Zhang, Jingjing; Tang, Shihuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药脑心通胶囊通过NF-κB/NLRP3/caspase-1信号通路减轻缺血性脑卒中后心脑损伤，分子对接仅用于药物-蛋白亲和力评估，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Ischemic stroke (IS) is a major cause of mortality. Inflammation exerts an essential part of brain-heart communication after IS. Naoxintong capsule (NXT), derived from the classical Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) formulation Bu-Yang-Huan-Wu-Tang, are extensively employed in China to manage IS, myocardial infarction (MI), and atherosclerosis. Previous clinical studies have demonstrated the protective effects of NXT in anti-atherosclerosis, cerebral infarction, angina, and acute coronary syndrome. However, the potential therapeutic mechanism of NXT for IS remains unknown. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aims to investigate a potential mechanism for enhancing brain-heart interaction following an ischemic stroke. MATERIALS AND METHODS: C57BL/6J mice underwent permanent middle cerebral artery occlusion (MCAO) for durations of 6, 12, and 24 h. The effects of NXT on the brain were observed via TTC, Nissl and TUNEL staining, immunofluorescence staining, and Zea-Longa scores. Simultaneously, the effects of NXT on the heart were evaluated via H&E staining and echocardiography. Inflammatory factors in heart and serum were determined via ELISA or luminex liquid suspension chip detection. Network pharmacology predicted the targets and signaling pathways of NXT. The binding affinity between potential targets and active compounds of NXT was assessed through molecular docking. The expression levels of IkappaBalpha, IKKbeta, NF-kappaB, NLRP3, and caspase-1 were evaluated via Western blotting. RESULTS: The Zea-Longa scores, infarct rate, and the rate of apoptosis in the brain at 6, 12, and 24 h of MCAO mice were markedly decreased by NXT. Additionally, they clearly enhanced the NeuN positive rate and prevented microglia from activating at 24 h. NXT significantly reduced the level of myocardial injury biomarkers (Lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) and Creatine kinase isoenzyme MB (CK-MB) at 24 h, N-terminal pro-brain natriuretic peptide (NT-pro BNP) at 6, 12, and 24 h), improved ejection fraction, fractional shortening, stroke volume, and cardiac output at 24 h. The levels of MIP-1alpha in cardiac tissue and IL-1beta in serum were both markedly lowered by NXT. Furthermore, the NF-kappaB/NLRP3/caspase-1 signaling pathways may be potential mechanisms of NXT. Molecular docking indicated that IKKbeta, IkappaBalpha, NF-kappaB, NLRP3, and caspase-1 may serve as potential targets for the action of representative active ingredients in NXT. NXT could reduce the expression levels of IKKbeta, NF-kappaB, NLRP3, and caspase-1 in brain and heart tissues while increasing the expression of IkappaBalpha. CONCLUSIONS: Our study illustrates that NXT efficiently attenuated inflammation in the brain and heart by blocking the NF-kappaB/NLRP3/caspase-1 signaling pathway. These findings provide appealing insights into the multi-organ perspective on human health via identifying shared inflammatory impacts and heart-brain linkages.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：缺血性卒中（IS）是导致死亡的主要原因。炎症在IS后的脑-心通讯中发挥重要作用。脑心通胶囊（NXT）源自经典中药（TCM）方剂补阳还五汤，在中国广泛用于治疗IS、心肌梗死（MI）和动脉粥样硬化。既往临床研究已证明NXT在抗动脉粥样硬化、脑梗死、心绞痛和急性冠脉综合征中的保护作用。然而，NXT对IS的潜在治疗机制仍不清楚。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨增强缺血性卒中后脑-心相互作用的潜在机制。材料与方法：C57BL/6J小鼠接受永久性大脑中动脉闭塞（MCAO）处理，持续时间分别为6、12和24小时。通过TTC、尼氏染色和TUNEL染色、免疫荧光染色以及Zea-Longa评分观察NXT对脑的影响。同时，通过H&E染色和超声心动图评估NXT对心脏的影响。通过ELISA或luminex液相悬浮芯片检测测定心脏和血清中的炎症因子。网络药理学预测了NXT的靶点和信号通路。通过分子对接评估NXT潜在靶点与活性化合物之间的结合亲和力。通过Western blotting评估IkappaBalpha、IKKbeta、NF-kappaB、NLRP3和caspase-1的表达水平。结果：NXT显著降低了MCAO小鼠在6、12和24小时的Zea-Longa评分、脑梗死率和脑组织凋亡率。此外，在24小时时，NXT明显提高了NeuN阳性率并阻止了小胶质细胞活化。NXT显著降低了心肌损伤生物标志物水平（24小时时的乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）和肌酸激酶同工酶MB（CK-MB），6、12和24小时时的N末端前脑钠肽（NT-pro BNP）），并在24小时时改善了射血分数、缩短分数、每搏输出量和心输出量。NXT显著降低了心脏组织中的MIP-1alpha水平和血清中的IL-1beta水平。此外，NF-kappaB/NLRP3/caspase-1信号通路可能是NXT的潜在机制。分子对接表明，IKKbeta、IkappaBalpha、NF-kappaB、NLRP3和caspase-1可能作为NXT中代表性活性成分作用的潜在靶点。NXT可降低脑和心脏组织中IKKbeta、NF-kappaB、NLRP3和caspase-1的表达水平，同时增加IkappaBalpha的表达。结论：我们的研究表明，NXT通过阻断NF-kappaB/NLRP3/caspase-1信号通路有效减轻了脑和心脏的炎症。这些发现通过识别共享的炎症影响和心-脑联系，为人类健康的多器官视角提供了有吸引力的见解。
